$comment: Ring and chain sizing references. Ring sizes follow ISO 8653: the numeric size in the ISO/EU system IS the inner circumference in millimetres. US/UK conversions are the standard trade equivalents.

ring_sizes.basis: ISO 8653 — EU size = inner circumference in mm
notes: Measure at the end of the day — fingers swell and can differ by half a size.
Wide bands (over 6mm) sit tighter; go up a half size.
Cold hands measure smaller. Do not size a ring in winter for summer wear.
